James A Haley Veterans Hospital and Clinics is looking for energetic leaders for the Nurse Manager position within the Spinal Cord Injury Unit. Functions as a clinical expert and is responsible for and accountable for all elements of the nursing process when providing or supervising direct patient care.

Assess plans, implements, and evaluates delivery of care based on age specific components. Assumes responsibility for the coordination of care focused on patient education, self-management, and customer satisfaction throughout the continuum of care.

Influences care outcomes by collaborating with members of the interdisciplinary team and creating innovative process improvement initiates. Core elements of performance include knowledge and active participation in the unit/program level of quality improvement process and initiatives as well as customer service programs.

Duties listed but not limited to: Provides oversight and direct supervision to assigned direct reports working in inpatient clinical medical/surgical units within SCI acute care with some oversight of Veterans on ventilators. The SCI NM effectively manages clinical and administrative responsibilities, as it relates to assigned clinical area.

Manages the daily tasks and activities of the medical/surgical units. The designated first-line supervisory authority and is responsible and accountable for the 24/7 operation of their assigned units and provides coverage for other NMs as needed. The NM provides leadership and supervision to the Assistant Nurse Manager(s) on the team.

The NM is responsible for staffing responsible unit(s) on a continual basis and validating data used for the staffing methodology process, if relevant.

The NM is responsible and accountable for the direction and supervision of specific orientation, training, development of staff, and timely evaluation of individual staff performance through proficiency and appraisal reviews. They function as a role model, educator, practitioner, and supervisor providing leadership to the team.

They influence care outcomes by collaborating with members of the interdisciplinary team to remove barriers and implement new evidence-based cutting-edge programs/processes. This includes the collection, analyzing, trending and reporting of data as it relates to nurse sensitive indicators and risk management findings.

The NM engages in professional organizations to enhance leadership and career growth. They adhere to ethical principles in decision-making, fostering accountability at personal, organizational, and staff levels. They collaborate with the Nurse Educators to ensure staff have the appropriate orientation plan and education for annual competencies.

They equip staff with tools for culturally competent care and promote a culture of accountability for high-quality, cost-effective outcomes. They cultivate alliances across the care continuum, building trust through active listening, engagement, and emotional intelligence.

VA offers a comprehensive total rewards package: VA Nurse Total Rewards Pay: Competitive salary, regular salary increases, potential for performance awards Paid Time Off: 50 days of paid time off per year (26 days of annual leave, 13 days of sick leave, 11 paid Federal holidays per year) Retirement: Traditional federal pension (5 years vesting) and federal 401K with up to 5% in contributions by VA Insurance: Federal health/vision/dental/term life/long-term care (many federal insurance programs can be carried into retirement) Licensure: 1 full and unrestricted license from any US State or territory Work Schedule: Monday through Friday, 07:30am-16:00pm Telework: Not Available Virtual: This is not a virtual position.

Relocation/Recruitment Incentives: May be Authorized EDRP Authorized: Not Authorized Permanent Change of Station (PCS): Not Authorized PCS Appraised Value Offer (AVO): Not Authorized
Basic Requirements: English Language Proficiency. In accordance with 38 U.S.C. 7403(f), no person shall serve in direct patient care positions unless they are proficient in basic written and spoken English.

Graduate of a school of professional nursing approved by the appropriate accrediting agency and accredited by one of the following accrediting bodies at the time the program was completed by the applicant: The Accreditation Commission for Education in Nursing (ACEN) or The Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE); OR Individuals attending a master's level bridge program in nursing who have completed coursework equivalent to a bachelor's level degree in Nursing may have opportunity to become registered as a nurse with a state licensing board prior to completion of the bridge program.

Upon achievement of a State license, the individual may be appointed on temporary basis and later converted to a permanent appointment upon successful completion and graduation from the bridge program.

(Reference VA Handbook 5005, Appendix G6); OR In cases of graduates of foreign schools of professional nursing, possession of a current, full, active, and unrestricted registration will meet the requirement for graduation from an approved school of professional nursing to warrant an appointment as a Nurse who has completed an associated degree/entry level Nursing education program.

Credit for foreign nursing education higher that associate degree/entry level requires a formal degree equivalency validation from a recognized equivalency evaluation accepted by VA such as International Consultants of Delaware (ICD).

Current, full, active, and unrestricted registration as a graduate professional nurse in a State, Territory or Commonwealth (i.e., Puerto Rico) of the United States, or the District of Columbia.

Graduate Nurse Technician (GNT) Exception: Candidates who otherwise meet the basic education requirements, but do not possess the required licensure, may be appointed at the entry step of the grade and level applicable to the completed nursing education as a GNT on a 120-day temporary appointment while actively pursuing licensure (may be extended up to two years on a case-by-case-basis.) NOTE: Grandfathering Provision - All persons currently employed in VHA in 0610 series and performing the duties as described in the qualification standard on the effective date of the standard (1/29/2024) are considered to have met all qualification requirements for the grade held including positive education and licensure/certification.

Grade Determinations: The following Scope, Education and Dimension criteria must be met in determining the grade assignment of candidates, and if appropriate, the level within a grade.

The Dimension requirements (Practice, Veteran/Patient Driven Care, Leadership, Professional Development and Evidence-Based Practice/Research) are detailed for each grade and level within the online assessment: https://apply.usastaffing.gov/ViewQuestionnaire/13005391.

Grade/Level Scope Education Nurse I, Level I Delivers fundamental, knowledge-based care to assigned clients while developing technical competencies. An Associate Degree (ADN) or Diploma in Nursing, with no additional professional nursing required.

Nurse I, Level II Demonstrates integration of biopsychosocial concepts, cognitive skills and technically competent practice in providing care to clients with basic or complex.

An ADN or Diploma in Nursing AND 1 year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse I, Level 1 ;OR a Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) with no additional professional nursing experience required. Nurse I, Level III Demonstrates proficiency in practice based on conscious and deliberate planning.

Self-directed in goal setting for managing complex client situations.

An ADN or Diploma in Nursing AND 2 years of professional nursing experience in which one year is equivalent to Nurse I, Level 2; OR a BSN and 1 year of professional nursing experience equivalent to the Nurse I, Level 2; OR a Master's degree in nursing (MSN) and no additional professional nursing experience; OR a Master's degree in a *related field with a BSN and no additional professional nursing experience.

Nurse II Demonstrates leadership in delivering and improving holistic care through collaborative strategies with others.

A BSN with 2 years of professional nursing equivalent to Nurse I, Level 3; OR an MSN with one year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse I, Level 3; OR a Master's degree in a *related field with a BSN and one year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse I, Level 3; OR a Doctoral degree in Nursing with no professional nursing experience; OR a Doctoral degree in a *related field with a BSN with no additional professional nursing experience.

Nurse III Executes position responsibilities that demonstrate leadership, experience and creative approaches to management of complex client care beyond the immediate practice setting.

MSN and 2 years of specialized nursing experience, one of which is equivalent to Nurse II and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse III; OR a Master's degree in *related field with BSN and two years of specialized nursing experience, one of which is equivalent to Nurse II and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse III; OR a Doctoral degree in Nursing with and one year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse II and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse III; OR a Doctoral degree in a *related field with a BSN and one year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse II and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse III. *Note: Foreign education programs/degrees are not creditable as related degrees.

Preferred Experiences: MSN 1-2 years of Spinal Cord Injury Nursing Experiences 1-2 years of Leadership Experiences (Chief Nurse, Nurse Manager, or Assistant Nurse Manager Reference: For more information on this qualification standard, please visit https://www.va.gov/ohrm/QualificationStandards/.

Physical Requirements: This position requires visual acuity, keen hearing, clear distinctive speech, and manual dexterity. This position requires potentially long periods of continued walking, standing, stooping, sitting, bending, pulling, and pushing. Transferring patients and objects may be required. Mechanical inpatient lifts are provided.

The incumbent may be exposed to infected patients and contaminated materials and may be required to don protective clothing in isolation situations, operative/invasive procedures, or home settings. The incumbent may occasionally be exposed to patients who are combative secondary to delirium, dementia, or psychiatric disorders.

The incumbent must be a mature, flexible, sensible individual capable of working effectively in stressful situations, able to shift priorities based on patient needs. Must complete annual Employee Health requirements, such as annual TB screening or testing, as a condition of employment.

The incumbent who provides care in home settings or other off-site locations may be required to drive and/or ride in GSA-vehicles.

The Inpatient Spinal Cord Injury/Disorder Registered Nurse will function as an integral member of the Spinal Cord Division. These are exciting opportunities to work in a diverse environment.

Position offers opportunities to provide bedside care for acute and chronic disease management, palliative care patients, rehabilitation and complex medical patients.

Responsibilities of the incumbent in this position include but are not limited to: Managing the day to day needs of an acutely ill patient population with spinal cord injuries/disorders (SCI/D) Medication administration and documentation requirements Health promotion, Veteran/Caregiver education and supporting patient self-determination Collaborative practice with interdisciplinary SCI/D team Application of principles of rehabilitation nursing care to promote the highest level of functional independence Adhering to established safety practices, delegating and guiding assistive personnel, and supporting process/quality improvement initiatives on the unit and across the organization Preferred Experience: BSN Preferred CRRN - Rehabilitation certification preferred Acute care nursing experience preferred Interest or experience in SCI/Rehabilitation Nursing preferred Ability to multitask and manage complex patient needs High level of flexibility/adaptability needed to meet fast paced environment Strong interpersonal, oral and written communication skills Committed to supporting a healthy work environment VA offers a comprehensive total rewards package: VA Nurse Total Rewards Pay: Competitive salary, regular salary increases, potential for performance awards Paid Time Off: Up to 50 days of paid time off per year (26 days of annual leave, 13 days of sick leave, 11 paid Federal holidays per year) Retirement: Traditional federal pension (5 years vesting) and federal 401K with up to 5% in contributions by VA Insurance: Federal health/vision/dental/term life/long-term care (many federal insurance programs can be carried into retirement) Licensure: 1 full and unrestricted license from any US State or territory Work Schedule: PMs - 1530-2400, Alternating weekends and holidays Telework: Not available Virtual: This is not a virtual position.

Relocation/Recruitment Incentives: Not authorized Permanent Change of Station (PCS): Not authorized

Ihre Expertise für eine professionelle Pflege
Ilanz liegt im Bündner Oberland an der Vorderrhein und bietet Sie eine malerische Arbeitsumgebung mit guter Verkehrsanbindung durch die Hauptverkehrsachse. Die Region besticht durch ihre Nähe zur Natur, kulturelle Vielfalt und das ausgeprägte Tourismusgewerbe. Als Arbeitsort attraktiv, finden Sie hier lebendige Wirtschaftsperspektiven, eine hohe Lebensqualität und Zugang zu innovativen Branchen in der Schweiz.

**Einsatzbeginn:** Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung
Sie sind eine erfahrene **Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/Pflegefachmann HF DN1** und suchen eine neue berufliche Herausforderung? Sie möchten Ihre umfassenden pflegerischen Fachkenntnisse in einem professionellen Umfeld einbringen und zur bestmöglichen Versorgung von Patientinnen und Patienten beitragen? Dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig!
Unser **Personalbüro für Pflege in Ilanz** vermittelt qualifizierte Pflegefachpersonen an **renommierte Spitäler, Langzeitpflegeeinrichtungen und Spitex-Organisationen in Ilanz und Umgebung**. Wir suchen engagierte Fachpersonen, die mit ihrer Fachkompetenz und Empathie zur hohen Qualität der Patientenbetreuung beitragen möchten.
**Ihre Aufgaben – Verantwortung und Fachkompetenz in der Pflege**
· Individuelle und ganzheitliche Pflege von Patientinnen und Patienten in akuten und chronischen Pflegesituationen
· Sicherstellung einer qualitativ hochwertigen Pflege durch evidenzbasierte Methoden
· Durchführung von medizinisch-technischen Verrichtungen wie Medikamentenmanagement, Infusionstherapie, Wundversorgung oder Schmerztherapie
· Planung, Durchführung und Evaluation von pflegerischen Maßnahmen unter Berücksichtigung von Gesundheitsförderung und Prävention
· Beratung und Begleitung von Angehörigen zur Unterstützung der Patientenversorgung
· Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit mit Ärztinnen, Ärzten, Therapeutinnen, Therapeuten und weiteren Fachpersonen
· Dokumentation und Qualitätssicherung gemäß den geltenden Vorschriften
**Ihr Profil – Fachliche Qualifikation und soziale Kompetenz**
· **Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/Pflegefachmann HF DN1**
· Berufserfahrung in der Akut-, Langzeit- oder Spitexpflege von Vorteil, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich
· Fundiertes pflegerisches Wissen und sicherer Umgang mit pflegerischen und medizinisch-technischen Maßnahmen
· Freude an der interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit mit Fachkräften aus verschiedenen Bereichen
· Selbstständige, verantwortungsbewusste und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
· Bereitschaft zur kontinuierlichen fachlichen Weiterbildung
· Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
**Unser Angebot – Ihre Qualifikation verdient Wertschätzung**
· **Offene Stellen für Pflege in Ilanz**, individuell auf Ihre Qualifikationen und Interessen abgestimmt
· **Temporärstellen für Pflege in Ilanz**, wenn Sie eine flexible Arbeitsgestaltung bevorzugen
· **Personalvermittlung für Pflege in Ilanz**, um die passende Einrichtung für Sie zu finden
· Individuelle Karriereberatung und gezielte Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
· Ein wertschätzendes Arbeitsklima mit modernster Infrastruktur
· Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen, faire Vergütung und umfassende Sozialleistungen

## Dipl. Pflegefachfrau Pflegefachmann FH Cham – Starte deine Karriere jetzt
Du suchst als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau oder Pflegefachmann FH Cham eine neue Aufgabe, und gleichzeitig möchtest du dein Wissen einsetzen und weiterkommen. Genau hier findest du die passende Chance, denn du arbeitest nah am Menschen, und du kannst täglich etwas bewirken.
Cham liegt zentral in der Zentralschweiz im Kanton Zug und besticht durch eine ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung mit direktem Zugang zur Autobahn sowie regelmäßigen Zugverbindungen. Die Nähe zu Zürich macht die Stadt für Pendler attraktiv. Sie profitieren von einem dynamischen Wirtschaftsstandort mit vielen modernen Arbeitsplätzen, hohem Wohlstandsniveau und einer hervorragenden Infrastruktur in einer malerischen Seenlandschaft.
Einsatzort: Cham und UmgebungEinsatzbeginn: Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung
Unser Personalbüro für Pflege in Cham unterstützt dich aktiv, sodass du schnell eine passende Stelle findest und gleichzeitig flexibel bleibst.
### Deine Aufgaben im Alltag als - Dipl. Pflegefachfrau Pflegefachmann FH Cham

The Veterans Affairs (VA) Office of Academic Affiliations (OAA) post baccalaureate registered nurse residency (PB-RNR) program is designed to produce a pipeline of highly qualified, veteran health care specialty-trained registered nurses (RNs) to deliver quality care to veterans within the VA or in the community.

The PBRNR Coordinator is responsible for providing competent, programmatic oversight to the PBRNR program which consists of a comprehensive 12-month curriculum built upon standards related to clinical, leadership, and professional dimensions.

Applicants should possess demonstrated experience in competent, evidence-based nursing care, adult learning principles, teaching/learning methodologies, and program management.

Duties include but are not limited to: Assesses, plans, implements, and evaluates the program based on established policies and guidelines consistent with the program mission, goals, and expected outcomes.

Responsible for the quality and quantity of program-specific training and establishes program initiatives and direction within limitations of available staff and budget. Promotes the transition from academia to clinical practice, integration into the organization, and socialization into the professional nurse role.

Develops, maintains, and administers a formal, data-driven, systematic plan for appraising the effectiveness of the PBRNR Program and disseminates program outcomes based on Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education Accreditation.

Oversight of additional programs as assigned VA offers a comprehensive total rewards package: VA Nurse Total Rewards Pay: Competitive salary, regular salary increases, potential for performance awards Paid Time Off: 50 days of paid time off per year (26 days of annual leave, 13 days of sick leave, 11 paid Federal holidays per year) Retirement: Traditional federal pension (5 years vesting) and federal 401K with up to 5% in contributions by VA Insurance: Federal health/vision/dental/term life/long-term care (many federal insurance programs can be carried into retirement) Licensure: 1 full and unrestricted license from any US State or territory Work Schedule: Monday - Friday, 8:00 am - 4:30 pm (Note: Work schedules are determined and approved by the supervisor.

The incumbent may be required to work various shifts on a permanent or temporary basis based on facility/patient care needs).
Basic Requirements: English Language Proficiency. In accordance with 38 U.S.C. 7403(f), no person shall serve in direct patient care positions unless they are proficient in basic written and spoken English.

Graduate of a school of professional nursing approved by the appropriate accrediting agency and accredited by one of the following accrediting bodies at the time the program was completed by the applicant: The Accreditation Commission for Education in Nursing (ACEN) or The Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE); OR Individuals attending a master's level bridge program in nursing who have completed coursework equivalent to a bachelor's level degree in Nursing may have opportunity to become registered as a nurse with a state licensing board prior to completion of the bridge program.

Upon achievement of a State license, the individual may be appointed on temporary basis and later converted to a permanent appointment upon successful completion and graduation from the bridge program.

(Reference VA Handbook 5005, Appendix G6); OR In cases of graduates of foreign schools of professional nursing, possession of a current, full, active, and unrestricted registration will meet the requirement for graduation from an approved school of professional nursing to warrant an appointment as a Nurse who has completed an associated degree/entry level Nursing education program.

Credit for foreign nursing education higher that associate degree/entry level requires a formal degree equivalency validation from a recognized equivalency evaluation accepted by VA such as International Consultants of Delaware (ICD).

Current, full, active, and unrestricted registration as a graduate professional nurse in a State, Territory or Commonwealth (i.e., Puerto Rico) of the United States, or the District of Columbia.

Graduate Nurse Technician (GNT) Exception: Candidates who otherwise meet the basic education requirements, but do not possess the required licensure, may be appointed at the entry step of the grade and level applicable to the completed nursing education as a GNT on a 120-day temporary appointment while actively pursuing licensure (may be extended up to two years on a case-by-case-basis.) NOTE: Grandfathering Provision - All persons currently employed in VHA in 0610 series and performing the duties as described in the qualification standard on the effective date of the standard (1/29/2024) are considered to have met all qualification requirements for the grade held including positive education and licensure/certification.

The Mental Health Intensive Case Management (MHICM) program seeks to optimize the health status, quality of life, and community functioning of Veterans diagnosed with serious mental illness who frequently utilize VA mental health inpatient and emergency services.The Registered Nurse (RN) - Mental Health Intensive Case Management is responsible for providing competent, evidence-based care to patients.

The person in this role will assist in directing the provision of nursing education, orientation, competencies and providing quality improvement and enhance outcomes utilization.

The MHICM program provides clinical community-based case management services to Veterans with serious mental illness (SMI), severe functional impairment, and high Inpatient MH unit utilization, in coordination with existing community and Veterans Affairs (VA) services.

The RN - MHICM is also responsible for the following duties: Providing outpatient, community-based MH services for a subgroup of Veterans with PMI; including but not limited to medication management and in home/community consultation. Responding to psychiatric and medical emergencies, as directed.

Documenting nursing triage assessments, risk screens, clinical reminders, and patient plan of care in accordance with facility policy. Maintaining professional boundaries to protect patient vulnerabilities and act in the best interest of the patient. Collaborating and supporting MH nursing, along with other disciplines.

Demonstrating the ability to cope with and manage competing priorities, demonstrating proficient practice and decision-making, deliberate planning, and critical thinking skills. Holding therapeutic groups at the VA, outings in the community, treatment plans and meets with Veterans one to one to develop goals. Other duties, as assigned.

Der Schwerpunkt dieser Stelle liegt in der Berufsbildung: Sie begleiten Lernende durch ihre Ausbildung, planen Lernangebote und nehmen Qualifikationen ab. Denn wer Nachwuchs stark macht, prägt die Pflege von morgen. Didaktisches Flair ist hier ebenso gefragt wie Fachkompetenz.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?
Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Pflegeprofis \& Talente (40% – 80%) für die offene Station, für unseren geschützten Wohnbereich und für unsere Aussenstation
==================================================================================================================================
Gemeinsam die Pflege von morgen gestalten – mit , Verstand und genau dem Pensum, das zu deinem Leben passt.
Egal, ob du frisch aus der Ausbildung kommst, mitten im Leben stehst oder mit über 50 Jahren deine wertvolle Erfahrung einbringen möchtest: Bei uns zählen deine Persönlichkeit und dein Fachwissen. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung motivierte Persönlichkeiten
**Deine Optionen: Finde deine perfekte**
**1\. Dipl. Pflegefachperson HF/FH oder FaGe (60% – 80%**
Idealeweise bringst du als HF das Zertifikat **SVEB 1,** oder als FaGe den **Berufsbildner\-Kurs** mit oder hast Lust, dich in der Berufsbildung zu engagieren.
* **Das tust du bei uns:** Du übernimmst die fachkompetente, ressourcenorientiert Pflege und Betreuung unserer Bewohnenden, sicherst durch Planung, Steuerung und Evaluation der Pflegeprozesse die Pflegequalität und begleitest Lernende auf ihrem Weg.

Du bist in der Tagesverantwortung geplant, berätst und begleitest Angehörige in Schwierigen Situationen und bist Bezugspflegende. Auf der geschützten Station sorgst Du mit Deiner Expertise für eine moderne, personenzentrierte Begleitung und Pflege von Menschen mit Demenz auf Augenhöhe.
* **Deine Extrameile:** Du arbeitest aktiv in internen Arbeitsgruppen mit, um unsere Prozesse und die Pflegequalität stetig weiterzuentwickeln.
**Das bringst du, bringt Ihr mit**
* Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung auf tertiärer Stufe (Dipl. HF/FH,AKP, DN2\), Fachfrau\-/mann Gesundheit EFZ oder eine vom SRK anerkannte ausländische Ausbildung.
* Als Diplomierte Pflegefachperson vielleicht Lust die Position als stellvertretende Stationsleitung zu übernehmen
* Spass an einem bewegtem Arbeitsumfeld
* Sinn für Humor, ein wenig Gelassenheit und trotzdem Ehrgeiz
* Freude an der interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit und dem Austausch zwischen den Generationen.
* Mut zu und Lust auf Veränderungen
* Teamgeist, welchen Du aktiv lebst
* Erfahrung in der Begleitung von Menschen mit Demenz auf Augenhöhe
**2\. Pflegehilfe SRK oder Assistent/\-in Gesundheit und Soziales AGS (60%\-80%)**
**Das tust du bei uns:**
Du unterstützt unser Team bei der täglichen Pflege und Betreuung, schenkst unseren Klienten ein Lächeln und sorgst für ein Wohlfühlambiente. Aktivierst und begleitest unsere Bewohnenden im Alltag, sorgst Dich um ihr Wohlbefinden und unterstützt sie bei der Erhaltung oder Förderung der vorhandenen Ressourcen. Auf der geschützten Station übernimmst Du mit Freude neben der allgemeinen Pflege auch die Gestaltung des Alltags für Menschen mit kognitiven Veränderungen.
**Das bringst du**
* Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Assistent Gesundheit und Soziales EBA oder einen zertifizierten Pflegehelfer/in SRK\-Kurs.
* Als Pflegehilfe oder AGS vielleicht schon mit Erfahrung als Inko\-Verantworliche/r
* Spass an einem bewegtem Arbeitsumfeld
* Sinn für Humor, ein wenig Gelassenheit und trotzdem Ehrgeiz
* Freude an der interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit und dem Austausch zwischen den Generationen.
* Mut zu und Lust auf Veränderungen
* Teamgeist, welchen Du aktiv lebst
* Erfahrung in der Begleitung von Menschen mit Demenz auf Augenhöhe
**Wir bieten „Das Flex\-Modell“: Volle oder halbe Dienste?**
Wir wissen, dass das Leben flexibel sein muss. Deshalb bieten wir dir zwei Modelle an:
* **Klassisch:** Du arbeitest in regulären Schichten mit einem Pensum von **60% bis 80%**.
* **Family \& Generationen\-Modell (Halbe Dienste):** Du wünschst dir mehr Zeit für Familie, Enkelkinder oder Hobbys? Bei uns kannst du dich auch ausschliesslich für **halbe Dienste** bewerben. In diesem Modell profitierst du von einem Pensum von **40% bis 60%**
* **Oder ein Mix aus beidem.** Z.B. in der Woche halbe Dienste und am Wochenende normale (ganze) Dienste
**Das bringen wir mit (Deine Vorteile)**
* **Weiterbildung wird bei uns grossgeschrieben:** Du willst vorwärtskommen? Wir fördern und unterstützen deine Teilnahme an internen und externen Weiterbildungen aktiv.
* **Mitarbeit, die Spass macht:** Bring deine Ideen in unseren Arbeitsgruppen ein – deine Meinung wird gehört und geschätzt.
* **Ein Team für alle Generationen:** Bei uns arbeiten und Hand in Hand. Wir schätzen den frischen Wind genauso wie die gelassene Lebenserfahrung.
* **Moderne Kultur:** Ein unkompliziertes, wertschätzendes Arbeitsklima auf Augenhöhe
* **Diversität:** Wir lieben alle Menschen, unabhängig von Kultur, Herkunft, Sexuelle Orientierung oder Gender\-Zugehörigkeit

Dans un établissement de pointe vous occupez un poste varié au sein d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire comprenant des infirmiers(-ères), des aides-soignants(-es), des médecins.
Vous devrez assurer l-accueil des patients atteints de pathologies polyvalentes, dans le cadre d-une prise en charge globale en phase aigüe.

* Installer le patient et lui présenter les informations d'organisation administrative et de soin
* Recueillir et transmettre les données médicales et administratives et compléter le dossier de soins informatisé

* Evaluer continuellement l'état clinique du patient et son évolution en situation aigue
* Identifier les situations de fragilité, de perte d'autonomie et de complexité nécessitant une approche interdisciplinaire ;
* Participer à la prise en charge de patients âgés et polymorbides, ainsi qu'à l'accompagnement de patients et de leurs proches confrontés à des situations palliatives ;
* Collaborer avec les différents intervenants afin d'assurer la continuité et la coordination des soins ;
* Assurer la coordination inter services pour la gestion des mouvements de patients
* Coordonner les entrées et sorties : les mutations internes, les transferts externes des patients en collaboration avec le cadre de santé.

* Diplôme d'infirmier(-ère)
* En possession de la reconnaissance croix rouge si diplôme étranger
* Disposant d'une expérience en médecine interne, en gériatrie, en soins palliatifs ou dans un domaine de soins complexes, un atout ;
* Présentant un intérêt marqué pour la prise en charge des patients âgés, polymorbides et/ou en situation palliative ;
* Sensible à l'approche globale et interdisciplinaire du patient ;
* Sens du contact et du service dans le cadre d'un établissement privé
* Autonome, bienveillance, polyvalence, capacité d'adaptation, d'organisation et sens des priorités sont des qualités essentielles
* Attitude positive au sein d'une équipe et êtes capable de générer un climat de confiance
* Capable de contribuer à instaurer un climat de confiance avec les patients, leurs proches et les différents professionnels.
**Un environnement en évolution**
